title: 5.3.12 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a second goal worth more, a bumper that slides, or a best score that survives a restart. Pick one, combine them, or invent one.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above, or more than one, or invent a rule of your own. Read the whole challenge before you start typing: each one asks you to change something the game already does, not to add a new screen.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: Write one sentence as a `//` comment at the very top of your code saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it. If you cannot say what would break, the rule may not be doing anything yet.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The second goal is worth 5' is a rule; 'I added a sprite' is not.

requirements.title: Your game has a rule of your own
requirements.description: Any one challenge counts, or a rule you invented: a second thing that scores, something on the table that moves, a best score kept across restarts, or a score worth something other than 1. Help: 5.3.8 (Lab: Three bumpers, three values)
